open_issues.fix: Re-source to 0603 100V C0G, same capacitance; update the BOM row and the footprint string in analog_frontend.py.
open_issues.resolution: BOM rev.5 -> GCM1885C2A220JA16D 0603/100V C0G; analog_frontend.py C_att_t now _c0603. No Basic-tier 100V 0603 C0G exists at 22pF (all Extended).

open_issues.issue: BAV199LT1G pin-3-as-common-node is EasyEDA-sourced, not manufacturer-verified. Input clamp orientation depends on it; if wrong the protection diodes do not clamp.
open_issues.fix: Verify pin function against the ON Semi datasheet; correct clamp orientation if needed.
open_issues.resolution: VERIFIED vs onsemi BAV199LT1/D Rev.13: series dual diode, pin3 = series midpoint (not a generic common node). Code orientation (pin1->GND, pin2->AVDD, pin3->signal) gives correct bidirectional clamping. Code was never wrong; the EasyEDA description was imprecise.

open_issues.issue: XO and gate decoupling sourced as 1uF 0603 rather than 100nF 0402. Worse HF impedance on the supply of the low-jitter oscillator that the entire 12-bit SNR budget depends on; supply noise converts to jitter.

open_issues.resolution: BOM rev.5 + clocking.py: C30/C31 now 100nF 0402 X7R. 100nF C0G does not exist in 0402 anywhere in JLC (max 0402 C0G = 470pF); X7R is best available.

Tying OUT2 to VCM_REF would buffer it and is electrically better against THS4521 VOCM bias current. Coder left it as a documented upgrade rather than re-deciding the architect's net plan.
open_issues.fix: Architect decision: buffer VCM_REF or keep the resistive divider. One-line change.

open_issues.issue: TVS (ESD9B5.0ST5G, Vrwm 5V/VBR 7.8V/15pF) sits directly on the BNC centre contact, UPSTREAM of both the 909k attenuator and the 1k limiter. Breaks 3 HARD requirements at once: F2 (at the rated +/-10V input the TVS is 2.2V past breakdown and conducting - the instrument cannot measure its own range), I3 (nothing limits current into it at +/-50V; it fails short), I2 (15pF takes Cin to ~35pF, outside a 10x probe's trim range, which is the whole reason I2 exists).
open_issues.fix: Move the clamp to CHn_BUFIN, behind R102, where BAV199 already sits and the signal swings 0-3.3V. Driver verified the relocation does NOT disturb the tau-matched divider (both legs stay 20.0us; the 15pF lands behind R102, not on the mid node). Architect must confirm the added R102/15pF pole at 10.6 MHz does not degrade the measured AAF response (-3dB 4.45MHz, -29.4dB at 10MHz).
open_issues.resolution_pending: Architecture rev.2: clamp moves to CHn_BUFIN AND the part changes to ESD9L5.0ST5G (0.9pF, C82326, SOD-923, UNIDIRECTIONAL - polarity now load-bearing). Relocating the 15pF part alone would have failed F8 at 3.83pF worst case. Awaiting coder + sourcer.
open_issues.resolution: Architecture rev.2 + coder: clamp moved to CHn_BUFIN and re-parted to ESD9L5.0ST5G (0.9pF). Verified in built netlist: CH1_BNC={J2.1,R100.1,C100.1} (no clamp); CH1_BUFIN={D100.3,D101.1,R102.2,U100.3}. F2/I3/I2 restored; F8 4.39MHz nominal, F9 -30.5dB.

open_issues.issue: TLV2372 (3 MHz RRIO CMOS) unity-gain follower drives ~300nF (C24+C113+C213) with no isolation resistor and feedback taken at the load - the classic ringing arrangement for this op-amp class. VREF_OFF feeds BOTH channels. Reviewer flagged this as an unsimulated RISK, not an asserted defect.
open_issues.fix: One 22 ohm isolation resistor using the spare R19 the power block already reserved.
open_issues.resolution: Upgraded from unsimulated risk to datasheet-backed defect: TI SLOS270F 8.3.2 requires RNULL >=20ohm above 10pF of load; this net is 300nF. R19=22ohm placed, feedback at the op-amp output, bypass caps on the load side. Verified VREF_OFF_AMP={U7.1,U7.2,R19.1} and VREF_OFF carries R19.2 plus all bypass caps.

open_issues.issue: The footprint validator resolves library paths and stops - it never sees the sourced MPN's package string, so it cannot detect a package-variant mismatch. Both footprint defects this run (U31 150 vs 208-mil SOIC-8; D101 SOD-523 vs SOD-923) had MATCHING pad counts and passed it green. A green validator run is not a footprint gate pass.
open_issues.fix: Upstream tooling gap, not a defect in this design. Worth feeding back to the plugin: the validator needs the BOM's package column to compare against.
